subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this umbrella issue remain canonical until Anthropic signed-thinking replay prevention lands, or should maintainers hand off the remaining work to the narrower open issue now that recovery-carrier fixes are on main?
rationale: The issue bundles fixed recovery-carrier defects with an unresolved replay-prevention policy choice, and the open candidate PRs carry compatibility and provider-routing tradeoffs that require maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open until a selected prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

options.title: Make Narrow Issue Canonical
options.body: Hand off the remaining prevention work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 once maintainers decide this umbrella has served its purpose.

options.title: Defer Prevention
options.body: Accept recovery-only mitigation for now and track future replay policy separately if production evidence continues after release.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until a selected prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already framed the fixed recovery half versus the remaining create/prevention half in the issue discussion.
